about_the_game:
This DLC requires the base game to be updated to version 0.8.12.0 or later to function properly.

The DLC introduces nearly 60 special alternate character skins (with more to be added in updates), integrated with the Character Transformation System.

These skins feature feminized designs, which may alter the original characters' genders, art styles, and more. Some outfits may include revealing clothing—minors are advised not to use this DLC.

This DLC is completely free, does not affect core gameplay, and can be enabled or disabled at will!

Important Notes:

  • All character designs in this DLC are contributed by players. Special thanks to Xuange, Luopan, Len Lian, Eliwod, and others for providing the first batch of skins.

  • Installing this DLC will replace some (but not all) default character models. You can also manually customize each character’s appearance in the Transformation System.

  • All skins are AI-generated. The author has rigorously reviewed them for copyright issues, but if any infringement is found, please contact us immediately for removal.

  • After applying this DLC, some historically inspired characters may undergo gender/style changes ("waifu-ization"). This is purely for anime-style creative fun and not intended to disrespect or misrepresent real historical figures. If uncomfortable with this, please do not install the DLC.

Call for Fan Art Submissions!

We’re expanding this DLC with more player-created character skins! Submit your designs under these guidelines:

  • Original creations (self-made or AI-generated) with no copyright violations.

  • Art style should match the base game, maintain character recognizability, and avoid explicit nudity (though mild fanservice is allowed).

  • Submit as transparent-background PNGs, minimum 500x500 resolution.

Join our QQ group to participate! Community feedback will help select skins for future updates!
